root_idea.summary: The root expresses what is behind, later, or contrary to precedence.
root_idea.development: From spatial or positional being behind, the root develops temporal lateness and postponement. آخَر denotes a non-first or additional item, while آخِر denotes what is last or subsequent and, when substantivized, the ultimate world or state of existence.

senses.definition: To put or leave someone or something behind, after, or later; to keep back.
senses.usage_conditions: A transitive causative use: what is put behind may be spatially posterior or later in an ordered sequence.

senses.definition: To postpone, defer, or grant respite until a later time.
senses.usage_conditions: A transitive temporal use, including delaying a person, an event, or an appointed term.

senses.definition: To be or become behind or later; to remain behind, lag, or be delayed.
senses.usage_conditions: An intransitive use describing a person or thing that follows another, remains in the rear, or occurs later.

senses.definition: To seek or be able to remain behind or be delayed; to seek postponement.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quranic constructions, the form concerns remaining later or delaying an appointed occurrence, without changing its fixed term.

senses.definition: Another, other, or an additional one; one distinct from the first or from the one already mentioned.
senses.usage_conditions: Used adjectivally or substantively, with masculine, feminine, singular, dual, and plural forms; it can identify the other member of a pair or an alternative item.

senses.definition: The remaining or last member of a group.
senses.usage_conditions: A conventional use with a group or sequence, especially in expressions referring to the last of a people.

senses.definition: Last, latter, aftermost, or at the end; the concluding one or part.
senses.usage_conditions: Used adjectivally or substantively for what follows the first or precedes no later item, including the end of a sequence or period.

senses.definition: The Hereafter; the ultimate world, life, or state of existence.
senses.usage_conditions: A substantivized use, often with الدار or الحياة understood or expressed, and contrasted with the present or worldly life.

senses.definition: One who comes later or remains behind; a later one.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quran occurrence is plural and refers to those who are later, including those later in sequence, birth, or emergence.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A reviling epithet for an outcast, an alienated or remote person, or a base and ignoble fellow; it may also be interpreted as the last speaker.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in cursing or reviling; the cited lexical discussion explicitly reports that it is not addressed to a female.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The back, hinder, or latter part of something; behind or backwards in adverbial use.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used for a rear portion or direction, contrasted with the front or forward part.

other_classical_meanings.definition: On deferred payment; on credit, with payment postponed to a future period.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A commercial construction equivalent to payment by a period of respite or deferment.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Relating to the other state of existence or the world to come.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A relational adjective formed from the lexical branch associated with the ultimate or other world.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The Last: the one who remains after all creatures have perished.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A divine name in theological usage, emphasizing continued existence after creation has passed away.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The two hindmost teats of a she-camel, those nearest the thighs.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An anatomical term contrasted with the two forward teats.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The rear part of a camel or horse saddle against which the rider leans.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A technical saddle term, contrasted with the forward or central part of the saddle.
A specialized meaning reported by some lexicographers and not treated as the ordinary sense of the headword.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The outer angle of the eye, the part next to the temple.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An anatomical term opposed to the inner or forward extremity next to the nose.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The Postponer or Delayer: the one who postpones or delays things and puts them in their appointed places.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A divine name, contrasted with المُقَدِّمُ, the one who brings forward.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A palm tree whose fruit remains until the end of winter or until the end of the fruit-cutting season.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A botanical term contrasted with an early-fruiting palm.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A person, author, or other entity of a later or more modern time.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A chronological use describing a later generation or period rather than merely a person who is physically behind.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To hold back from, refrain from, or abstain from a thing or affair.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional Form V construction with عَنْ; this specialized construction is broader than the Quranic uses represented under the Form V sense.
